profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: IT Applications developer with a passion for working on customer-facing applications and websites. Hobbyist for developing games in my free time using Unity or modern web technologies.

positions.title: Information Technology Application Developer
positions.description:
●	Maintain and extend large pre-existing code bases in AngularJS, Angular 7, and Java.
●	Develop responsive, robust, and optimized web pages capable of integrating and presenting multiple data sources.
●	Migrate legacy code from AngularJS to Angular 7.
●	Cooperate in an agile team to deliver coordinated solutions for business needs. 
●	Leverage tools such as Jenkins and Concourse for CI/CD.
●	Utilize New Relic and Contrast for monitoring capabilities.

positions.title: President
positions.description:
●	Organized and operated weekly competitive gaming events on campus.
●	Delegated responsibilities amongst cabinet members to represent different gaming communities and organize new events for the students.
●	Coordinated with local schools to create inter-collegiate competitions.
●	Developed promotional materials such as posters, fliers, stream overlays and online advertisements for events.

positions.title: Test Automation Developer Intern
positions.description:
●	Worked in an existing test automation code base for SOAP and REST web services for enterprise customer information files.
●	Developed new tests in Gherkin format from the ground-up to cover more test cases.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
●	Adapted legacy systems into modern programming paradigms.
●	Ensured the quality of software that was actively shipped to customers in personal lines.
